summary.text: John Cabello, a Republican, represents Illinois's 90th House District; the General Assembly lists his service as August 2012 to January 2021 and January 2023 to the present.

paragraphs.text: According to the biography, he was appointed to fill a vacancy in the 68th District in August 2012 and elected that November.
He worked as a police officer in South Beloit and Rockford for nearly three decades, and previously served as a Harlem Township trustee and Winnebago County Board member.
The biography says he graduated from Harlem High School and lives in Machesney Park.
